summary: Mineral County, MT lookout: L-4 cab dated 1936 and destroyed 1955 per firelookout.com; the association lists it as ground and gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955 according to firelookout.com; the Forest Fire Lookout Association also lists it as gone

events.note: The page dates the L-4 cab to 1936
The page says the cab was destroyed in 1955; no cause is given

evidence.supports: site in the Lolo National Forest
two miles south of St. Regis, Mineral County
page title Cold Peak Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Dates come from one page only (firelookout.com). The Forest Fire Lookout Association list agrees on Ground and Gone but gives no dates. Two WebSearch queries and three page reads found no separate Cold Peak history, no Lolo National Forest record and no removal cause. A Montana History Portal photo titled 'Cold Peak fire lookout' appeared in a search snippet only; it is unverified and not used. The brief's kind 'ground' and status 'gone' are consistent with the sources, so no corrections. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
